lower_wing.reading: The four panels are separated by solid, wide, capped posts. Reprojecting the published eastern ground photograph shows five joined keyhole-like openings per interval. Each has a round raised head, a narrow lower opening, and a short connecting slot. The distant sky and trees show in portions of these openings.
lower_wing.roof_line_note: The front of the tiled part does not sit on top of the pierced parapet. The east standing wall at X=21.40 places the raised eave at source pixel (430,114), around Y5.0, Z13.36. The conditionally closed band terminates at this depth; the long eastern hall continues outside the section.

white_guard.material: Cream openwork panel above the brick band
white_guard.observation: Two different storeys each show eleven to twelve apertures per row and five staggered rows in the nearest bay. Tree-shadowed distant rows are not independently countable.

steps.note: The paved descent is visible below the middle gallery. Nearby plants obscure its roots. Treads at undergrowth on either side are omitted.
